blocks.zh: Appendix 3: Glossary / 術語詞彙表
blocks.en: Appendix 3: Glossary

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 縮寫總覽與分類導讀
blocks.en: Overview of Abbreviations and Categories

blocks.zh: HVAC 與空氣處理相關術語
blocks.en: HVAC and Air Handling Terms

blocks.zh: ACH / ACR — 換氣次數/換氣率：衡量潔淨室空氣品質的核心指標
blocks.en: ACH / ACR — Air changes per hour / air change rate: a core indicator of cleanroom air quality

blocks.zh: AHU — 空調箱：潔淨室空氣處理的核心設備
blocks.en: AHU — Air handling unit: the core equipment for cleanroom air treatment

blocks.zh: ASHRAE — 美國暖通空調工程師學會：HVAC 設計標準的主要來源
blocks.en: ASHRAE — American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers: a primary source of HVAC design standards

blocks.zh: HEPA — 高效微粒空氣過濾器：潔淨室的關鍵過濾元件
blocks.en: HEPA — High-efficiency particulate air filter: the key filtration element of a cleanroom

blocks.zh: HVAC — 暖通空調系統：設施設計的核心系統
blocks.en: HVAC — Heating, ventilation and air conditioning system: a core system in facility design

blocks.zh: MERV — 最低效率報告值：過濾器效率分級
blocks.en: MERV — Minimum efficiency reporting value: a filter efficiency rating

blocks.zh: UAF / UFH — 單向氣流/單向氣流罩（層流罩）
blocks.en: UAF / UFH — Unidirectional airflow / unidirectional flow hood (laminar flow hood)

blocks.zh: ULPA — 超低穿透空氣過濾器
blocks.en: ULPA — Ultra-low penetration air filter

blocks.zh: VAV — 可變風量系統
blocks.en: VAV — Variable air volume system

blocks.zh: 屏障系統與隔離技術
blocks.en: Barrier Systems and Isolation Technology

blocks.zh: RABS — 限制進入屏障系統：開放式設計，依賴氣流溢出保護
blocks.en: RABS — Restricted access barrier system: an open design that relies on air overspill for protection

blocks.zh: RTP — 快速轉移埠：隔離器進出料的關鍵介面
blocks.en: RTP — Rapid transfer port: the key interface for transferring materials into and out of an isolator

blocks.zh: VHP — 氣相過氧化氫：隔離器去污的首選方法
blocks.en: VHP — Vaporized hydrogen peroxide: the preferred method for isolator decontamination

blocks.zh: BFS — 吹灌封：先進無菌製程技術
blocks.en: BFS — Blow-fill-seal: an advanced aseptic processing technology

blocks.zh: 品質與法規相關
blocks.en: Quality and Regulatory Terms

blocks.zh: cGMP — 現行良好生產規範
blocks.en: cGMP — Current good manufacturing practice

blocks.zh: CPP / CQA — 關鍵製程參數/關鍵品質屬性
blocks.en: CPP / CQA — Critical process parameter / critical quality attribute

blocks.zh: QbD — 品質源於設計：現代藥品開發核心理念
blocks.en: QbD — Quality by design: the core concept of modern drug development

blocks.zh: ICH — 國際協和會議：全球藥品法規協調機構
blocks.en: ICH — International Council for Harmonisation: the global body for harmonizing pharmaceutical regulation

blocks.zh: PIC/S — 藥品稽查合作組織
blocks.en: PIC/S — Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme

blocks.zh: EM / EMS — 環境監測/環境監測系統
blocks.en: EM / EMS — Environmental monitoring / environmental monitoring system

blocks.zh: CFU — 菌落形成單位：微生物計數的標準單位
blocks.en: CFU — Colony-forming unit: the standard unit for microbial counts

blocks.zh: 製程與公用設備
blocks.en: Process and Utilities

blocks.zh: CIP / SIP — 就地清洗/就地滅菌
blocks.en: CIP / SIP — Clean-in-place / sterilize-in-place

blocks.zh: WFI — 注射用水：無菌製造最高等級的水
blocks.en: WFI — Water for injection: the highest grade of water in sterile manufacturing

blocks.zh: TOC — 總有機碳：水質監測關鍵參數
blocks.en: TOC — Total organic carbon: a key parameter for water quality monitoring

blocks.zh: PAT — 製程分析技術
blocks.en: PAT — Process analytical technology

blocks.zh: FIT — 過濾器完整性測試
blocks.en: FIT — Filter integrity test

blocks.zh: CCIT — 容器密封完整性測試
blocks.en: CCIT — Container closure integrity test

blocks.zh: 易混淆縮寫提醒
blocks.en: Commonly Confused Abbreviations

blocks.zh: DOP vs. DEHS vs. PAO — 三者都是 HEPA 過濾器完整性測試用的氣溶膠介質。DOP（鄰苯二甲酸二辛酯）因健康疑慮已被 DEHS 或 PAO 取代，但業界仍慣稱「DOP 測試」
blocks.en: DOP vs. DEHS vs. PAO — All three are aerosol challenge media used for HEPA filter integrity testing. DOP (dioctyl phthalate) has been replaced by DEHS or PAO because of health concerns, but the industry still commonly calls it the "DOP test"

blocks.zh: DP — 壓差（Differential Pressure），非「藥品」(Drug Product)。在設施設計文件中，DP 幾乎都指壓差
blocks.en: DP — Differential pressure, not Drug Product. In facility design documents, DP almost always means differential pressure

blocks.zh: RSR — 房間側可更換（HEPA 過濾器安裝方式），非 RSF（殘餘密封力）
blocks.en: RSR — Room-side replaceable (a HEPA filter installation method), not RSF (residual sealing force)

blocks.zh: CNC vs. UC — CNC（受控但未分級）有過濾通風，UC（未分級）為一般支援區域
blocks.en: CNC vs. UC — CNC (controlled not classified) areas have filtered ventilation, while UC (unclassified) areas are general support areas

blocks.zh: 定義 A – B：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions A – B: Commentary

blocks.zh: 潔淨室狀態三部曲 (ISO 14644-1)
blocks.en: The Three Cleanroom States (ISO 14644-1)

blocks.zh: 理解潔淨室的三種測試狀態是設施確效的基礎：
blocks.en: Understanding the three cleanroom test states is fundamental to facility qualification:

blocks.zh: As-Built（竣工態） — 設施完工、服務已連接且運作，但無生產設備、物料或人員。這是驗收建築工程時的測試狀態
blocks.en: As-Built — The facility is complete, services are connected and operating, but there is no production equipment, material or personnel. This is the test state used when accepting the construction work

blocks.zh: At Rest（靜態） — 設備已安裝並運轉，但無操作人員。用於確認 HVAC 系統能力
blocks.en: At Rest — Equipment is installed and running, but no operating personnel are present. Used to confirm the capability of the HVAC system

blocks.zh: In Operation（動態） — 正常生產狀態，人員在場操作。這是日常環境監測的測試條件
blocks.en: In Operation — Normal production state with personnel present and working. This is the test condition for routine environmental monitoring

blocks.zh: CDMO 角度：客戶稽核常要求提供這三種狀態的粒子數據，必須清楚區分並保存完整記錄。
blocks.en: CDMO perspective: client audits often ask for particle data in all three states, so they must be clearly distinguished and complete records kept.

blocks.zh: 無菌核心區相關術語群
blocks.en: Terms Related to the Aseptic Core

blocks.zh: 無菌（Aseptic） — 不含致病微生物
blocks.en: Aseptic — Free from pathogenic microorganisms

blocks.zh: 無菌製程（Aseptic Processing） — 在受控環境中處理無菌物料，控制空氣、物料、設備與人員以維持可接受的微生物和微粒汙染水準
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing — Handling sterile materials in a controlled environment, controlling air, materials, equipment and personnel to maintain acceptable levels of microbial and particulate contamination

blocks.zh: 無菌核心區（Aseptic Processing Area / Aseptic Core） — 產品調配、充填、封裝的區域
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing Area / Aseptic Core — The area where product is compounded, filled and sealed

blocks.zh: 無菌製程模擬（Aseptic Process Simulation） — 即培養基模擬充填（Media Fill），用培養基取代產品以評估製程無菌保證能力
blocks.en: Aseptic Process Simulation — Also known as media fill: replacing the product with culture medium to evaluate the aseptic assurance capability of the process

blocks.zh: Alert Point vs. Action Level — 常見混淆
blocks.en: Alert Point vs. Action Level: A Common Confusion

blocks.zh: Alert Point（警戒點） — 參數正在偏向操作範圍的極端值。觸發時需要關注和趨勢分析，但不一定要立即停線
blocks.en: Alert Point — A parameter is drifting toward the extreme of its operating range. When triggered, it calls for attention and trend analysis, but does not necessarily require stopping the line immediately

blocks.zh: Action Level（行動限度） — 超過時必須立即介入，包括調查原因和採取矯正措施
blocks.en: Action Level — When exceeded, immediate intervention is required, including investigating the cause and taking corrective action

blocks.zh: 實務提醒：環境監測計畫中，Alert 和 Action 限度的設定依據必須有數據支持（通常基於歷史趨勢數據），不能隨意訂定。
blocks.en: Practical reminder: in an environmental monitoring program, the basis for setting Alert and Action limits must be supported by data (usually historical trend data) and cannot be set arbitrarily.

blocks.zh: 屏障系統 (Barrier System)
blocks.en: Barrier System

blocks.zh: 屏障系統是利用物理隔板提供 ISO 5/Grade A 保護的系統，透過氣流將其內部與周圍環境部分隔離。
blocks.en: A barrier system uses physical partitions to provide ISO 5/Grade A protection and partially separates its interior from the surrounding environment through airflow.

blocks.zh: 關鍵字：「部分隔離」(partially separating) — 這是 RABS 與隔離器 (Isolator) 的根本區別。RABS 依賴氣流溢出 (air overspill)，而非完全密封。
blocks.en: Key phrase: "partially separating". This is the fundamental difference between RABS and an isolator. RABS relies on air overspill rather than a complete seal.

blocks.zh: 其他重要 A-B 術語
blocks.en: Other Important A-B Terms

blocks.zh: 接受標準（Acceptance Criteria） — 判定測試結果是否可接受的可量測條件
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria — Measurable conditions used to determine whether a test result is acceptable

blocks.zh: 安瓿（Ampoule） — 全玻璃或全塑膠的熱封容器，用於無菌注射藥品
blocks.en: Ampoule — An all-glass or all-plastic heat-sealed container used for sterile injectable drugs

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌釜（Autoclave） — 以濕熱（蒸汽）加壓滅菌的設備
blocks.en: Autoclave — Equipment that sterilizes using pressurized moist heat (steam)

blocks.zh: 背景環境（Background Environment） — 圍繞關鍵區的環境（如 ISO 7/Grade B 區圍繞 ISO 5/Grade A 區）
blocks.en: Background Environment — The environment surrounding a critical zone (for example, an ISO 7/Grade B area surrounding an ISO 5/Grade A area)

blocks.zh: 生物負荷（Bioburden） — 每單位體積的微生物濃度，包括病毒、細菌、酵母菌、黴菌及其碎片
blocks.en: Bioburden — The concentration of microorganisms per unit volume, including viruses, bacteria, yeasts, molds and their fragments

blocks.zh: 雙向動線（Bidirectional Traffic） — 人員和物料可以從同一區域進出的動線模式
blocks.en: Bidirectional Traffic — A flow pattern in which personnel and materials enter and exit through the same area

blocks.zh: 定義 C：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions C: Commentary

blocks.zh: 空間分級系統 — 最重要的設施設計基礎
blocks.en: Space Classification System: The Most Important Foundation of Facility Design

blocks.zh: Classified Space（分級空間） — 空氣中活性和非活性粒子汙染控制在預設限度內的區域。ISO 14644-1 標準或 EU GMP Annex 1 Grade A/B/C/D。重點：分級空間意味著必須持續進行環境監測
blocks.en: Classified Space — An area in which airborne viable and non-viable particle contamination is controlled within predefined limits, per ISO 14644-1 or EU GMP Annex 1 Grade A/B/C/D. Key point: a classified space means environmental monitoring must be performed continuously

blocks.zh: Clean Area（潔淨區） — 指定了微粒和微生物水準的區域（如充填室 ISO 7/Grade B）
blocks.en: Clean Area — An area with specified particulate and microbiological levels (for example, a filling room at ISO 7/Grade B)

blocks.zh: Cleanroom（潔淨室） — ISO 14644-1 定義：控制空氣中微粒濃度的房間，其建造和使用方式可最大限度減少微粒的引入、產生和滯留
blocks.en: Cleanroom — ISO 14644-1 definition: a room in which the concentration of airborne particles is controlled, and which is constructed and used in a manner that minimizes the introduction, generation and retention of particles

blocks.zh: CNC — 受控但未分級 — 沒有空氣微粒限度但有過濾通風。常見於更衣室外側、走廊等過渡區域
blocks.en: CNC — Controlled Not Classified — No airborne particle limits but with filtered ventilation. Commonly found in transition areas such as the outer side of gowning rooms and corridors

blocks.zh: Open Process vs. Closed Process — 關鍵區別
blocks.en: Open Process vs. Closed Process: A Key Distinction

blocks.zh: 封閉製程（Closed Process）：產品、物料或關鍵組件被密封在封閉設備中，與環境隔離。封閉製程可以在較低等級的環境中進行。
blocks.en: Closed Process: The product, materials or critical components are sealed in closed equipment and isolated from the environment. A closed process can be carried out in a lower-grade environment.

blocks.zh: 對比：開放製程（Open Process）在後續段落中定義 — 產品暴露於環境中，必須在相應的高等級環境下操作。
blocks.en: By contrast, an Open Process is defined in a later paragraph: the product is exposed to the environment and must be handled in a correspondingly higher-grade environment.

blocks.zh: CDMO 營運影響：能夠論證製程為「封閉」是降低設施分級要求（從而降低營運成本）的重要策略。
blocks.en: CDMO operational impact: being able to justify a process as "closed" is an important strategy for lowering facility classification requirements (and therefore operating costs).

blocks.zh: 品質設計三角：CPP、CQA、Critical Process Step
blocks.en: The Quality-by-Design Triangle: CPP, CQA, Critical Process Step

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性） — 確保產品品質所需的物理、化學、生物或微生物特性
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute) — A physical, chemical, biological or microbiological property required to ensure product quality

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數） — 其變異會影響 CQA 的製程參數，需要監控或控制
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter) — A process parameter whose variability affects a CQA and therefore needs to be monitored or controlled

blocks.zh: Critical Process Step（關鍵製程步驟） — 對無菌產品而言，通常是產品或產品接觸面暴露於周圍環境的步驟
blocks.en: Critical Process Step — For a sterile product, usually a step in which the product or product-contact surfaces are exposed to the surrounding environment

blocks.zh: 三者的邏輯鏈：識別 CQA → 確定影響 CQA 的 CPP → 找出涉及暴露的 Critical Process Step → 設計相應的設施保護措施。
blocks.en: The logical chain of the three: identify the CQAs, determine the CPPs that affect the CQAs, find the Critical Process Steps that involve exposure, then design the corresponding facility protection measures.

blocks.zh: 其他重要 C 術語
blocks.en: Other Important C Terms

blocks.zh: 校正（Calibration） — 將已知精度的標準與待測儀器比較，消除精度偏差。校正是確效的基礎工作
blocks.en: Calibration — Comparing a standard of known accuracy with the instrument under test to eliminate accuracy deviations. Calibration is a foundation of qualification and validation work

blocks.zh: 試運轉（Commissioning） — 設備和系統安裝後的文件化驗證過程。注意：Commissioning 不等同於 Qualification，但兩者密切相關（參見 ISPE Vol.5）
blocks.en: Commissioning — The documented verification process after equipment and systems are installed. Note: Commissioning is not the same as Qualification, but the two are closely related (see ISPE Vol.5)

blocks.zh: 調配（Compounding） — 將活性成分、賦形劑和溶劑混合成均質藥液
blocks.en: Compounding — Mixing the active ingredient, excipients and solvent into a homogeneous drug solution

blocks.zh: 藥典（Compendial） — 符合 USP（美國藥典）、EP（歐洲藥典）或 JP（日本藥典）的官方標準
blocks.en: Compendial — Conforming to the official standards of the USP (United States Pharmacopeia), EP (European Pharmacopoeia) or JP (Japanese Pharmacopoeia)

blocks.zh: 交叉汙染（Cross-Contamination） — 不同原料或產品之間的相互汙染。CDMO 多產品設施必須特別關注
blocks.en: Cross-Contamination — Contamination between different raw materials or products. CDMO multi-product facilities must pay particular attention to it

blocks.zh: 同時生產（Concurrent Processing） — 同一時間處理兩種以上產品。需要嚴格的隔離和防交叉汙染措施
blocks.en: Concurrent Processing — Processing two or more products at the same time. Requires strict segregation and cross-contamination prevention measures

blocks.zh: 定義 D – F：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions D – F: Commentary

blocks.zh: Disinfection vs. Sanitization vs. Decontamination — 三者有何不同？
blocks.en: Disinfection vs. Sanitization vs. Decontamination: How Do They Differ?

blocks.zh: 消毒（Disinfection） — 去除、破壞或滅活物體或表面上的微生物。較廣泛的概念
blocks.en: Disinfection — Removing, destroying or inactivating microorganisms on objects or surfaces. The broader concept

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒（Sanitization） — 去汙的一部分，將活微生物降至已定義的可接受水準。通常使用化學劑或熱
blocks.en: Sanitization — A part of decontamination that reduces viable microorganisms to a defined acceptable level. Usually uses chemical agents or heat

blocks.zh: 去汙（Decontamination） — 使用殺孢子劑消除活性生物負荷。最為徹底，適用於隔離器等高要求場景
blocks.en: Decontamination — Using a sporicidal agent to eliminate viable bioburden. The most thorough, and suited to demanding applications such as isolators

blocks.zh: 層級關係：Decontamination（最嚴格）> Disinfection > Sanitization。選擇何種方法取決於目標微生物和環境分級。
blocks.en: Hierarchy: Decontamination (most stringent) > Disinfection > Sanitization. Which method to choose depends on the target microorganisms and the environmental classification.

blocks.zh: 滅菌與去熱原相關術語
blocks.en: Sterilization and Depyrogenation Terms

blocks.zh: 去熱原（Depyrogenation） — 去除或破壞內毒素。通常需要 250°C 乾熱處理
blocks.en: Depyrogenation — Removing or destroying endotoxin. Usually requires dry heat treatment at 250°C

blocks.zh: 乾熱滅菌（Dry Heat Sterilization） — 使用加熱烤箱或連續隧道進行滅菌，適用於玻璃器皿和金屬部件。250°C 可同時達到滅菌和去熱原的效果
blocks.en: Dry Heat Sterilization — Sterilization using a heated oven or continuous tunnel, suitable for glassware and metal parts. 250°C achieves both sterilization and depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 內毒素（Endotoxin） — 革蘭氏陰性菌的細胞壁碎片（脂多醣），可引起發熱反應
blocks.en: Endotoxin — Cell wall fragments (lipopolysaccharides) of Gram-negative bacteria that can cause a fever response

blocks.zh: 致熱原（Pyrogen） — 能引起體溫升高的物質，通常指細菌內毒素
blocks.en: Pyrogen — A substance that can cause a rise in body temperature, usually meaning bacterial endotoxin

blocks.zh: 壓差 (DP) 與設計限度
blocks.en: Differential Pressure (DP) and Design Limits

blocks.zh: 壓差（Differential Pressure） — 相鄰房間或區域之間的壓力差，以帕斯卡 (Pa) 計量。1 英寸水柱 = 254 Pa。壓差梯度是維持潔淨室分級的關鍵手段
blocks.en: Differential Pressure — The pressure difference between adjacent rooms or areas, measured in pascals (Pa). 1 inch of water column = 254 Pa. Pressure differential cascades are a key means of maintaining cleanroom classification

blocks.zh: 設計限度（Design Limit） — 設計師用於確定工程系統性能要求的受控變量範圍或精度
blocks.en: Design Limit — The range or accuracy of a controlled variable used by designers to determine the performance requirements of engineered systems

blocks.zh: 環境製程限度（Environmental Process Limits） — 超過時可能對產品品質產生不良影響的環境限度
blocks.en: Environmental Process Limits — Environmental limits which, if exceeded, may adversely affect product quality

blocks.zh: 其他 D-F 術語
blocks.en: Other D-F Terms

blocks.zh: 拋棄式耗材（Disposables） — 預滅菌的一次性產品、設備和包材。即 Single-Use Systems（SUS），是現代 CDMO 降低交叉汙染風險的重要工具
blocks.en: Disposables — Pre-sterilized single-use products, equipment and packaging materials. Also known as Single-Use Systems (SUS), an important tool for modern CDMOs to reduce the risk of cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 可萃取物（Extractables） — 使用溶劑可從高分子材料中提取的化學物質。與 Leachables（溶出物）構成 E&L 研究的兩個面向
blocks.en: Extractables — Chemicals that can be extracted from polymeric materials using solvents. Together with Leachables, they form the two aspects of E&L studies

blocks.zh: 賦形劑（Excipient） — 藥品配方中的非活性成分
blocks.en: Excipient — An inactive ingredient in a drug formulation

blocks.zh: 動線（Flow） — 設施中物料或人員的交通動線模式，是建築設計用語
blocks.en: Flow — The traffic pattern of materials or personnel in a facility; an architectural design term

blocks.zh: 配方（Formulation） — 藥品的化學和物理組成（名詞）；或調配藥品的行為（動詞）
blocks.en: Formulation — The chemical and physical composition of a drug (noun); or the act of preparing the drug (verb)

blocks.zh: 定義 G – L：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions G – L: Commentary

blocks.zh: 隔離器 (Isolator) vs. RABS vs. 局部保護 (Local Protection)
blocks.en: Isolator vs. RABS vs. Local Protection

blocks.zh: 這三個術語代表無菌保護的三種不同程度：
blocks.en: These three terms represent three different levels of aseptic protection:

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator） — 經去汙的 ISO 5/Grade A 單元，提供「不妥協的、連續的」隔離。可以是開放式或封閉式。隔離器是最高等級的屏障技術
blocks.en: Isolator — A decontaminated ISO 5/Grade A unit that provides "uncompromising, continuous" isolation. It can be open or closed. The isolator is the highest level of barrier technology

blocks.zh: RABS（限制進入屏障系統） — 提供封閉但非密閉的環境，利用剛性壁和氣流溢出隔離內部與外部。保護程度次於隔離器
blocks.en: RABS (Restricted Access Barrier System) — Provides an enclosed but not closed environment, using rigid walls and air overspill to separate the interior from the exterior. Offers less protection than an isolator

blocks.zh: 局部保護（Local Protection） — HEPA 過濾空氣罩或其他適當裝置，保護產品免受環境汙染物影響。最基本的保護手段
blocks.en: Local Protection — A HEPA-filtered air hood or other suitable device that protects the product from environmental contaminants. The most basic means of protection

blocks.zh: 保護等級：Isolator > RABS > Local Protection (LP/GAAS)。
blocks.en: Protection level: Isolator > RABS > Local Protection (LP/GAAS).

blocks.zh: CDMO 決策：隔離器前期投資高但可降低背景環境要求（ISO 7 或 ISO 8 即可），RABS 仍需 ISO 7/Grade B 背景。選擇需考量產品類型、批量和客戶要求。
blocks.en: CDMO decision: an isolator requires higher upfront investment but lowers the background environment requirement (ISO 7 or ISO 8 is sufficient), whereas RABS still needs an ISO 7/Grade B background. The choice should consider product type, batch size and client requirements.

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器 — 潔淨室的守門員
blocks.en: HEPA Filters: The Gatekeepers of the Cleanroom

blocks.zh: 高效微粒空氣（HEPA）過濾器：對 0.3 µm 粒子的過濾效率超過 99.97%。
blocks.en: A high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filter has a filtration efficiency of more than 99.97% for 0.3 µm particles.

blocks.zh: 關鍵知識點：
blocks.en: Key knowledge points:

blocks.zh: 0.3 µm 是 HEPA 過濾器效率最低的粒子尺寸（Most Penetrating Particle Size, MPPS）
blocks.en: 0.3 µm is the particle size at which a HEPA filter is least efficient (Most Penetrating Particle Size, MPPS)

blocks.zh: 對比 ULPA：超低穿透空氣過濾器效率更高（99.999% 對 0.12 µm），用於特殊高要求場景
blocks.en: In comparison, an ultra-low penetration air (ULPA) filter is more efficient (99.999% at 0.12 µm) and is used in special, more demanding applications

blocks.zh: RSR（Room Side Replaceable）安裝方式允許從潔淨室側更換過濾器，避免技術夾層汙染風險
blocks.en: The RSR (Room Side Replaceable) installation method allows filters to be replaced from the cleanroom side, avoiding the contamination risk of the technical interstitial space

blocks.zh: Extractables vs. Leachables — E&L 研究核心區別
blocks.en: Extractables vs. Leachables: The Core Distinction in E&L Studies

blocks.zh: 可萃取物（Extractables） — 使用強溶劑從高分子材料中萃取的化學物質。代表「最壞情況」的潛在遷移物質
blocks.en: Extractables — Chemicals extracted from polymeric materials using strong solvents. They represent the "worst-case" potential migrants

blocks.zh: 溶出物（Leachables） — Extractables 的子集。在正常使用/儲存條件下，從設備或容器遷移至藥品中的物質
blocks.en: Leachables — A subset of Extractables. Substances that migrate from equipment or containers into the drug product under normal use/storage conditions

blocks.zh: 關係：Extractables 研究先行（篩查），Leachables 研究隨後（實際條件驗證）。CDMO 必須為每個客戶產品進行 E&L 評估。
blocks.en: Relationship: Extractables studies come first (screening), followed by Leachables studies (confirmation under actual conditions). A CDMO must perform an E&L assessment for each client product.

blocks.zh: 其他 G-L 術語
blocks.en: Other G-L Terms

blocks.zh: 更衣（Gowning） — 防護服裝及穿著防護服裝的動作。更衣程序是人員汙染控制的核心環節
blocks.en: Gowning — Protective garments and the act of putting them on. The gowning procedure is a core element of personnel contamination control

blocks.zh: 親水性（Hydrophilic） — 對水有強親和力。其反義詞為疏水性（Hydrophobic）。影響過濾器選擇和材料相容性
blocks.en: Hydrophilic — Having a strong affinity for water. The opposite is hydrophobic. Affects filter selection and material compatibility

blocks.zh: 遲滯（Hysteresis） — 從相反方向接近某測量值時讀數的差異。校正時需要考量的儀器特性
blocks.en: Hysteresis — The difference in reading when a measured value is approached from opposite directions. An instrument characteristic that must be considered during calibration

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥機（Lyophilizer） — 即凍乾機。凍乾（Lyophilization）是將液體通過冷凍、昇華和解吸附轉化為固體的過程
blocks.en: Lyophilizer — A freeze dryer. Lyophilization is the process of converting a liquid into a solid through freezing, sublimation and desorption

blocks.zh: 製程中控制（IPC） — 生產期間進行的檢查，監控並適時調整製程以確保產品符合規格
blocks.en: In-Process Control (IPC) — Checks performed during production to monitor and, if necessary, adjust the process so that the product meets its specification

blocks.zh: 定義 M – O：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions M – O: Commentary

blocks.zh: 培養基充填試驗 (Media Fill) — CDMO 的核心能力指標
blocks.en: Media Fill: A Core Capability Indicator for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 培養基充填（Media Fill）是使用微生物培養基替代產品來評估無菌製程效能的方法，又稱製程模擬試驗（Process Simulation Test）或無菌製程模擬（Aseptic Process Simulation）。
blocks.en: Media Fill is a method that uses microbiological growth medium in place of product to evaluate the performance of an aseptic process. It is also called a Process Simulation Test or Aseptic Process Simulation.

blocks.zh: 為何 CDMO 必須精通此術語：
blocks.en: Why a CDMO must master this term:

blocks.zh: Media Fill 是證明無菌保證能力的法規要求
blocks.en: Media Fill is a regulatory requirement to demonstrate sterility assurance capability

blocks.zh: 客戶稽核幾乎必問 Media Fill 的頻率、批量、合格標準
blocks.en: Client audits almost always ask about Media Fill frequency, batch size and acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 對 Media Fill 有更嚴格的要求
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) sets stricter requirements for Media Fill

blocks.zh: 詳細內容可參考 PDA TR22（本知識庫已收錄）
blocks.en: For details, see PDA TR22 (included in this knowledge base)

blocks.zh: Open Process vs. Closed Process — 對照理解
blocks.en: Open Process vs. Closed Process: A Side-by-Side View

blocks.zh: 開放製程（Open Process） — 產品、物料或容器/密封表面暴露於周圍環境中，且此暴露可能影響產品品質或純度
blocks.en: Open Process — The product, materials or container/closure surfaces are exposed to the surrounding environment, and this exposure may affect product quality or purity

blocks.zh: 封閉製程（Closed Process） — 前面已定義：產品在封閉設備中與環境隔離
blocks.en: Closed Process — Defined earlier: the product is isolated from the environment in closed equipment

blocks.zh: 設施設計影響：開放製程步驟的環境等級要求通常比封閉製程高 1-2 個等級。例如，開放充填需要 ISO 5/Grade A，而封閉系統中的調配可在較低等級下進行。
blocks.en: Facility design impact: the environmental grade requirement for an open process step is usually 1-2 grades higher than for a closed process. For example, open filling requires ISO 5/Grade A, whereas compounding in a closed system can be done at a lower grade.

blocks.zh: 監測 (Monitoring) — ISO 14644-2 的精確定義
blocks.en: Monitoring: The Precise Definition in ISO 14644-2

blocks.zh: 監測是按照既定方法和計畫進行的測量觀察，以提供設施性能的證據。
blocks.en: Monitoring is the observation of measurements made according to an established method and plan, to provide evidence of the performance of the facility.

blocks.zh: 關鍵要素：
blocks.en: Key elements:

blocks.zh: 必須有「定義的方法和計畫」（defined method and plan）
blocks.en: There must be a "defined method and plan"

blocks.zh: 目的是提供「安裝性能的證據」
blocks.en: The purpose is to provide "evidence of installation performance"

blocks.zh: 可用於檢測操作狀態的趨勢
blocks.en: It can be used to detect trends in the operating state

blocks.zh: 與「驗證」(Verification) 和「確效」(Validation) 有不同的法規含義
blocks.en: It carries different regulatory implications from Verification and Validation

blocks.zh: 其他 M-O 術語
blocks.en: Other M-O Terms

blocks.zh: 可維護性（Maintainability） — 執行維護的容易程度。設施設計應考量：設備是否易於拆卸清潔？HEPA 是否易於更換？
blocks.en: Maintainability — The ease with which maintenance can be performed. Facility design should consider: is the equipment easy to dismantle for cleaning? Is the HEPA filter easy to replace?

blocks.zh: 正常操作條件（Normal Operating Condition） — 製程運作時通常觀察到的參數值，應在 Alert 和 Action 限度內
blocks.en: Normal Operating Condition — The parameter values typically observed while the process is running, which should lie within the Alert and Action limits

blocks.zh: 非活性的（Non-Viable） — 非活的，Viable 的反義詞。環境監測分為 viable（活性微粒）和 non-viable（非活性微粒）兩類
blocks.en: Non-Viable — Not living; the opposite of Viable. Environmental monitoring is divided into two types: viable (living particles) and non-viable (non-living particles)

blocks.zh: 加蓋壓鋁蓋（Overseal） — 即 capping and crimping，西林瓶封裝的最後步驟
blocks.en: Overseal — Capping and crimping, the final step in sealing a vial

blocks.zh: 臭氧消耗物質（ODS） — 含氯氟碳或溴碳的化學物質，環保法規限制使用
blocks.en: Ozone-Depleting Substances (ODS) — Chemicals containing chlorofluorocarbons or bromocarbons, whose use is restricted by environmental regulations

blocks.zh: 定義 P – Q：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions P – Q: Commentary

blocks.zh: 隔離策略：Physical vs. Procedural vs. Temporal Separation
blocks.en: Segregation Strategies: Physical vs. Procedural vs. Temporal Separation

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.3 定義了三種防止交叉汙染的隔離策略：
blocks.en: ISPE Vol.3 defines three segregation strategies for preventing cross-contamination:

blocks.zh: 物理隔離（Physical/Spatial Separation） — 通過物理屏障隔離物料、空間或操作，防止混合或重疊。最可靠的方法
blocks.en: Physical/Spatial Separation — Separating materials, spaces or operations by physical barriers to prevent mixing or overlap. The most reliable method

blocks.zh: 程序隔離（Procedural Separation） — 通過操作控制手段隔離物料、空間或操作。依賴 SOP 執行
blocks.en: Procedural Separation — Separating materials, spaces or operations by operational controls. Relies on SOP execution

blocks.zh: 時間隔離（Temporal Separation = Campaigning） — 確保兩種物料不在同一時間存在於同一空間
blocks.en: Temporal Separation (Campaigning) — Ensuring that two materials are not present in the same space at the same time

blocks.zh: 可靠性排序：Physical > Temporal > Procedural。CDMO 多產品設施通常結合三種策略使用。
blocks.en: Reliability ranking: Physical > Temporal > Procedural. CDMO multi-product facilities usually combine all three strategies.

blocks.zh: 接觸面分類 — Process Contact vs. Product Contact
blocks.en: Surface Classification: Process Contact vs. Product Contact

blocks.zh: 製程接觸面（Process Contact Surface） — ASME BPE 定義：在設計操作條件下，與原料、中間品、API、潔淨公用設備（如 WFI、CIP、純蒸汽、製程氣體）或組件（如膠塞）接觸或可能接觸的表面
blocks.en: Process Contact Surface — ASME BPE definition: a surface that is in contact, or may come into contact, under design operating conditions, with raw materials, intermediates, API, clean utilities (such as WFI, CIP, pure steam, process gases) or components (such as rubber stoppers)

blocks.zh: 產品接觸面（Product Contact Surface） — Process Contact Surface 的子集，與「產品」（由業主/使用者定義）接觸或可能接觸的表面
blocks.en: Product Contact Surface — A subset of Process Contact Surface: a surface that is in contact, or may come into contact, with the "product" (as defined by the owner/user)

blocks.zh: 區分意義：產品接觸面有更嚴格的材質、表面粗糙度和清潔驗證要求。
blocks.en: Why the distinction matters: product contact surfaces have stricter requirements for material, surface roughness and cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: 水系統層級 — Pure Steam, WFI, Purified Water
blocks.en: Water System Hierarchy: Pure Steam, WFI, Purified Water

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽（Pure Steam） — 水加熱至 100°C 以上並以防止源水夾帶的方式汽化。用於蒸汽與產品或製備物接觸的場合
blocks.en: Pure Steam — Water heated above 100°C and vaporized in a way that prevents entrainment of the source water. Used where the steam comes into contact with product or preparations

blocks.zh: 注射用水（WFI） — 通過蒸餾或反滲透純化，符合細菌內毒素限度（<0.25 EU/ml）。無菌製造的最高水質要求
blocks.en: Water for Injection (WFI) — Purified by distillation or reverse osmosis and meeting the bacterial endotoxin limit (<0.25 EU/ml). The highest water quality requirement in sterile manufacturing

blocks.zh: 純化水（Purified Water） — 用於製備藥品（不包括需要無菌和/或無熱原水的藥品）
blocks.en: Purified Water — Used in the preparation of medicinal products other than those requiring sterile and/or pyrogen-free water

blocks.zh: 品質等級：Pure Steam > WFI > Purified Water。詳見 ISPE Baseline Vol.4 Water & Steam Systems。
blocks.en: Quality ranking: Pure Steam > WFI > Purified Water. See ISPE Baseline Vol.4 Water & Steam Systems for details.

blocks.zh: 品質體系 — ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 與 QbD
blocks.en: Quality System: ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 and QbD

blocks.zh: Q8 — 藥品開發（Pharmaceutical Development）
blocks.en: Q8 — Pharmaceutical Development

blocks.zh: Q9 — 品質風險管理（Quality Risk Management）
blocks.en: Q9 — Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: Q10 — 藥品品質體系（Pharmaceutical Quality Systems）
blocks.en: Q10 — Pharmaceutical Quality System

blocks.zh: QbD（品質源於設計） — 從預定義目標開始，強調基於科學和風險管理的產品與製程理解
blocks.en: QbD (Quality by Design) — Starts with predefined objectives and emphasizes product and process understanding based on science and risk management

blocks.zh: 確效（Qualification） — 證明設備正確安裝、正常運作且產生預期結果的文件化行為。注意：Qualification 是 Validation 的一部分，但單獨的確效步驟不構成製程驗證
blocks.en: Qualification — The documented act of demonstrating that equipment is correctly installed, operates properly and produces the expected results. Note: Qualification is part of Validation, but individual qualification steps on their own do not constitute process validation

blocks.zh: Qualification vs. Validation — 精確區分
blocks.en: Qualification vs. Validation: A Precise Distinction

blocks.zh: 許多人混用這兩個術語，但 ISPE 的定義非常明確：
blocks.en: Many people use these two terms interchangeably, but the ISPE definitions are very clear:

blocks.zh: Qualification — 針對「設備和輔助系統」，證明安裝正確、運作正常、結果符合預期。包括 IQ/OQ/PQ
blocks.en: Qualification — Applies to "equipment and ancillary systems": demonstrating that they are installed correctly, operate properly and give the expected results. Includes IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: Validation（製程驗證） — 針對「製程」，提供高度保證特定製程能持續產出符合預定接受標準的結果
blocks.en: Validation (process validation) — Applies to "processes": providing a high degree of assurance that a specific process will consistently produce results that meet predetermined acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 簡記：Qualification 是確認「設備能力」，Validation 是確認「製程能力」。
blocks.en: Simple rule of thumb: Qualification confirms "equipment capability", Validation confirms "process capability".

blocks.zh: 定義 R – S：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions R – S: Commentary

blocks.zh: RABS — 限制進入屏障系統的精確定義
blocks.en: RABS: The Precise Definition of a Restricted Access Barrier System

blocks.zh: RABS：一種無菌製程系統，提供「封閉但非密閉」(enclosed, but not closed) 的環境，符合 ISO 5/Grade A 條件，利用剛性壁和氣流溢出 (air overspill) 將內部與周圍環境隔離。
blocks.en: RABS: An aseptic processing system that provides an "enclosed, but not closed" environment meeting ISO 5/Grade A conditions, using rigid walls and air overspill to separate the interior from the surrounding environment.

blocks.zh: 關鍵措辭解析：
blocks.en: Analysis of the key wording:

blocks.zh: "enclosed, but not closed" — 這是 RABS 與 Isolator 的核心區別。RABS 有物理圍護但不是氣密的
blocks.en: "enclosed, but not closed" — This is the core difference between RABS and an Isolator. RABS has a physical enclosure but is not airtight

blocks.zh: "air overspill" — RABS 的保護機制：正壓氣流從內部溢出，防止外部空氣侵入
blocks.en: "air overspill" — The protection mechanism of RABS: positive-pressure airflow spills out from the interior, preventing outside air from entering

blocks.zh: "rigid wall enclosure" — 使用剛性壁（非柔性隔簾），是 RABS 區別於普通潔淨室的特徵
blocks.en: "rigid wall enclosure" — Uses rigid walls (not flexible curtains), which is what distinguishes RABS from an ordinary cleanroom

blocks.zh: 詳細比較可參考本知識庫 PDA PtC-12（RABS 專題）和 PDA PtC-Isolators（隔離器專題）。
blocks.en: For a detailed comparison, see PDA PtC-12 (RABS topic) and PDA PtC-Isolators (isolator topic) in this knowledge base.

blocks.zh: 恢復時間 (Recovery Time) — HVAC 設計的關鍵指標
blocks.en: Recovery Time: A Key HVAC Design Metric

blocks.zh: 恢復時間：房間 HVAC 環境參數受到擾動後恢復至正常條件所需的時間。
blocks.en: Recovery Time: The time required for a room's HVAC environmental parameters to return to normal conditions after a disturbance.

blocks.zh: 最少需要 6-10 次換氣才能恢復（取決於擾動嚴重程度、送風品質和空氣混合程度）
blocks.en: At least 6-10 air changes are needed for recovery (depending on the severity of the disturbance, the quality of the supply air and the degree of air mixing)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 要求 Grade B 區域的恢復時間應在 15-20 分鐘內回到靜態標準
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 requires Grade B areas to recover to the at-rest standard within 15-20 minutes

blocks.zh: 恢復時間測試是潔淨室確效的必要項目
blocks.en: Recovery time testing is a required part of cleanroom qualification

blocks.zh: 滅菌相關術語群
blocks.en: Terms Related to Sterility and Sterilization

blocks.zh: 無菌（Sterile） — 無生命存在；通常指無活性微生物。注意：儘管表述為絕對概念，實際上以機率表示
blocks.en: Sterile — Free of living organisms; usually meaning free of viable microorganisms. Note: although expressed as an absolute concept, in practice it is expressed as a probability

blocks.zh: 滅菌（Sterilization） — 破壞或消除所有生命形式的過程（物理或化學）。通常以 PNSU（非無菌單位機率）表示，如 10-6
blocks.en: Sterilization — A process (physical or chemical) that destroys or eliminates all forms of life. Usually expressed as PNSU (probability of a non-sterile unit), such as 10-6

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾器（Sterilizing Filter） — 在以 Brevundimonas diminuta（最小挑戰微生物）最少 107/cm2 濃度挑戰時，產生無菌流出液的過濾器。詳見 PDA TR26
blocks.en: Sterilizing Filter — A filter that produces a sterile effluent when challenged with Brevundimonas diminuta (the minimum challenge organism) at a concentration of at least 107/cm2. See PDA TR26

blocks.zh: 殺孢子劑（Sporicidal Agent） — 能破壞細菌和真菌孢子的化學劑。孢子是最耐受的微生物形態
blocks.en: Sporicidal Agent — A chemical agent that can destroy bacterial and fungal spores. Spores are the most resistant form of microorganism

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒（Sanitization） — 去汙的一部分，將活微生物降至定義的可接受水準
blocks.en: Sanitization — A part of decontamination that reduces viable microorganisms to a defined acceptable level

blocks.zh: 其他 R-S 術語
blocks.en: Other R-S Terms

blocks.zh: 相對濕度（RH） — 室內空氣中水蒸氣含量，以百分比表示。HVAC 控制參數之一
blocks.en: Relative Humidity (RH) — The amount of water vapor in room air, expressed as a percentage. One of the HVAC control parameters

blocks.zh: 風險評估（Risk Assessment） — 組織資訊以支持風險管理決策的系統化過程。包括危害識別、風險分析和風險評價
blocks.en: Risk Assessment — A systematic process of organizing information to support a risk management decision. Includes hazard identification, risk analysis and risk evaluation

blocks.zh: 標準操作程序（SOP） — 規定如何完成某項活動的指示文件
blocks.en: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) — A document of instructions specifying how an activity is to be carried out

blocks.zh: 定義 T – W：中文解說
blocks.en: Definitions T – W: Commentary

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌 vs. 無菌製程 — 兩大無菌策略
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization vs. Aseptic Processing: The Two Sterility Strategies

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilization） — 將已密封在最終容器中的非無菌產品轉化為無菌產品的過程。通常使用高壓蒸汽或輻射
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization — The process of converting a non-sterile product, already sealed in its final container, into a sterile product. Usually uses autoclaving or irradiation

blocks.zh: 無菌製程（Aseptic Processing） — 在受控環境中處理已滅菌物料，全程維持無菌狀態
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing — Handling sterilized materials in a controlled environment, maintaining sterility throughout

blocks.zh: 選擇依據：若產品可耐受最終滅菌條件（熱、輻射），應優先採用最終滅菌，因其提供更高的無菌保證水準（SAL 10<sup>-6</sup>）。許多生物製劑無法耐受，只能使用無菌製程。
blocks.en: Basis for selection: if the product can tolerate terminal sterilization conditions (heat, radiation), terminal sterilization should be preferred because it provides a higher sterility assurance level (SAL 10<sup>-6</sup>). Many biologics cannot tolerate it and can only use aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: CDMO 角度：大多數 CDMO 客戶的產品為生物製劑，需要無菌充填而非最終滅菌。
blocks.en: CDMO perspective: most CDMO client products are biologics, which require aseptic filling rather than terminal sterilization.

blocks.zh: 單向氣流 (UAF) — 潔淨室空氣動力學的核心
blocks.en: Unidirectional Airflow (UAF): The Core of Cleanroom Aerodynamics

blocks.zh: 單向氣流（Unidirectional Airflow）：通過潔淨區整個橫截面的受控氣流，具有穩定的速度和近似平行的流線。此類型的氣流能將粒子從潔淨區定向輸送出去。
blocks.en: Unidirectional Airflow: Controlled airflow through the entire cross-section of a clean zone with steady velocity and approximately parallel streamlines. This type of airflow directionally carries particles out of the clean zone.

blocks.zh: ISO 5/Grade A 區域必須使用單向氣流
blocks.en: ISO 5/Grade A areas must use unidirectional airflow

blocks.zh: 典型速度：0.36-0.54 m/s（依據 EU GMP Annex 1）
blocks.en: Typical velocity: 0.36-0.54 m/s (per EU GMP Annex 1)

blocks.zh: 「層流」(Laminar Flow) 一詞在技術上不精確，正式術語應為 UAF
blocks.en: The term "laminar flow" is technically imprecise; the formal term should be UAF

blocks.zh: Terminal Filter（末端過濾器）安裝於送風入口處（通常在天花板），是實現 UAF 的硬體基礎
blocks.en: The terminal filter is installed at the supply air inlet (usually in the ceiling) and is the hardware basis for achieving UAF

blocks.zh: 容器與包材術語
blocks.en: Container and Packaging Terms

blocks.zh: 西林瓶（Vial） — 注射或診斷產品的最終容器，以橡膠塞封和鋁蓋（Overseal）密封。通常要求為第一類硼矽酸鹽玻璃。詳見 PDA TR87（玻璃瓶處理）和 PDA TR43（容器缺陷分類）
blocks.en: Vial — The final container for injectable or diagnostic products, sealed with a rubber stopper and an aluminum overseal. Type I borosilicate glass is usually required. See PDA TR87 (glass vial handling) and PDA TR43 (classification of container defects)

blocks.zh: Parison — BFS（吹灌封）製程中從模頭擠出的中空熔融塑料管，由氣壓在模具中膨脹成容器
blocks.en: Parison — In the BFS (blow-fill-seal) process, the hollow tube of molten plastic extruded from the die head, which is inflated by air pressure in the mold to form the container

blocks.zh: 其他 T-W 術語
blocks.en: Other T-W Terms

blocks.zh: 時間隔離（Temporal Separation / Campaigning） — 確保兩種物料不同時存在於同一空間。CDMO 多產品設施的常用策略
blocks.en: Temporal Separation / Campaigning — Ensuring that two materials are not present in the same space at the same time. A common strategy in CDMO multi-product facilities

blocks.zh: 未分級區域（Unclassified Area） — 製造區外圍的支援區域（如倉庫、辦公室）
blocks.en: Unclassified Area — A support area outside the manufacturing area (such as a warehouse or office)

blocks.zh: URS（使用者需求規格） — 規格文件系列的第一份，描述使用者對專案範圍的期望，強調產品參數和製程性能參數
blocks.en: URS (User Requirements Specification) — The first of the series of specification documents, describing the user's expectations for the project scope, with emphasis on product parameters and process performance parameters

blocks.zh: 驗證（Verification） — 審查、檢驗、測試、檢查、稽核或以其他方式確認項目是否符合規定要求
blocks.en: Verification — Reviewing, inspecting, testing, checking, auditing or otherwise confirming whether an item conforms to specified requirements

blocks.zh: WFI（注射用水） — 通過蒸餾或反滲透純化，細菌內毒素 <0.25 EU/ml
blocks.en: WFI (Water for Injection) — Purified by distillation or reverse osmosis; bacterial endotoxin <0.25 EU/ml

blocks.zh: 揮發性（Volatility） — 衡量物質在常溫下形成蒸氣的速度，影響清潔劑和消毒劑的選擇
blocks.en: Volatility — A measure of how quickly a substance forms vapor at ambient temperature; affects the choice of cleaning agents and disinfectants
